sourceDocuments.title: National Universities Commission Benchmark Minimum Academic Standards
sourceDocuments.text: Programmatic university accreditation mandates a minimum staff-to-student ratio of one to fifteen in clinical sciences and one to thirty in social sciences, with qualified doctoral degree holders composing at least sixty percent of instructional academic faculty.
